title: DashLoc launches DashDesk AI customer support platform
description: DashLoc launched DashDesk on August 31, 2026, an AI-powered support platform consolidating ticket management, automation, and customer communication into one workspace. The tool targets 10 industries, including retail, healthcare, and banking, to cut platform-switching and automate routine triage.

title: Capacity pricing gains ground as 80% of AI software vendors choose fixed commitments: Bain
description: The report, based on an analysis of publicly available pricing across around 200 B2B software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies, said capacity models offer customers more predictable budgets while allowing vendors to maintain more stable revenue.

title: Multibagger AI stock in focus after bagging Rs 1,000 crore term sheet to provide Nvidia Blackwell GPUs
description: E2E Networks will be in focus after signing a binding term sheet worth approximately Rs 1,000 crore with an Indian sovereign AI company to provide NVIDIA Blackwell cloud GPUs and allied services until June 2029. The development comes alongside the company’s Rs 1,500 crore fundraising plan and strong Q1 FY27 performance.

title: Taiwan's Lai says AI computing demand requires stronger global chip cooperation
description: President Lai Ching-te says Taiwan will work with countries worldwide to diversify chip production and build a more resilient supply chain.
